judge_notes.opus5: The safe-harbor cliff arithmetic (i0) is company-disclosed and has an exact -15% precedent a year ago, but I cut it hard for the +28.7-point put skew, the 21.9%-of-float short that produced +38.6% in February on the same bar (i3), and a Q4 consensus resting on one undated aggregator.
judge_notes.opus55: The company's own safe-harbor disclosures ($202M of agreements against about $194M recognised or guided) imply a roughly $75M Q4 cliff, and a flat Q4 consensus does not show it. A 22% short interest and the put skew damp this.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Safe-harbor revenue cliff into the Q4 guide against flat street Q4 and weak US residential peers, shrunk by a 22% crowded short, a +38.6% squeeze precedent and a 56% drawdown that already discounts a lot.
judge_notes.fable51: The 5% safe-harbor book is nearly exhausted so Q4 loses ~$75m against a flat Q4 consensus, the same shape as the Oct-2025 -15% print; a 22% short, +29 put skew and the Feb squeeze precedent say much of it is priced.
